predecessors.name: County of Urbino
predecessors.text: Pesaro e Urbino province with Gubbio

successors.name: Papal States
successors.text: Pesaro e Urbino province with Gubbio and Senigallia, the extent of the 5,556 km2 duchy

ledger.x: 22 July 1444: Oddantonio is assassinated and Federico da Montefeltro seizes Urbino, 'recognized only as Count of Urbino'.
1474: Sixtus IV makes Federico Duke of Urbino.
1503: the Borgia rule ends (page: 'in 1502-03'); the dukedom passes to the Della Rovere in 1508 on Guidobaldo's death.
10 April 1508: Guidobaldo da Montefeltro dies without children after adopting his sister Giovanna's firstborn; Francesco Maria I della Rovere reigns 1508-1516 (table).
1516: Pope Leo X's nephew Lorenzo II de' Medici takes Urbino (table: reign 1516-1519).
1523: the capital moves from Urbino to Pesaro.
23 April 1631: Francesco Maria II dies and Urban VIII takes the duchy.
1631: the Duchy of Urbino ends with the last Della Rovere duke.

wars.name: Cesare Borgia's conquest of Urbino
wars.outcome: Cesare Borgia ruled Urbino for 'a short rule' in 1502-1503 and the dukedom then returned to the Della Rovere.

certainty.note: No page gives boundaries; provinces and circles are readings.
